payload.summary: Greptile on PR #101 (MAR-2918): acceptance decisions that filter validation issues must use the untruncated issue list and be tested beyond the 100-issue report cap.
payload.mistake: The conflict-tolerant read path was correct, but no test proved that a blocking issue reported after 99 tolerated conflicts still blocks, or that 100 tolerated conflicts alone stay readable.
guidance: Filter ValidatedRecordScan.issues, never the truncated ValidateResult.errors, when deciding whether an operation may proceed.
Truncate only the reported VALIDATION_FAILED details after filtering.
verification: Cover acceptance filters with more than 99 tolerated issues plus a later blocking issue, and with the tolerated issues alone.
